title: Personalized prediction of immunotherapy response in lung cancer patients using advanced radiomics and deep learning
summary: Radiomic survival prediction in 206 immunotherapy patients reports improved progression-free survival discrimination and patient-group separation. This record is limited to the study result and does not establish independent replication or real-world benefit.
organization: National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University; University of Texas Southwestern Medical Center

evidence.tested: Radiomic survival prediction in 206 immunotherapy patients reports improved progression-free survival discrimination and patient-group separation.
evidence.unknown: No prospective clinical benefit or broader external validity is established by the documented study.
